# outline

Prints the file-scoped symbol outline for one Pascal unit. Reach for it when
you want a unit's symbol list outside the IDE.

## Running it from the CLI
```
drag-lint outline --file <path.pas> [--db <path>]
```
`--file <path.pas>` is the unit to outline.
